lines.japanese: 「おい成田！　チンタラやってんじゃねえよ、こっちも片しとけ！」
lines.english: “Hey, Narita! Quit dragging your ass. Clear this side too!”

lines.japanese: 少し離れた場所から、俺より年下っぽいバイト作業員に命令された。
lines.english: A casual laborer who looked younger than me barked the order from some distance away.

lines.japanese: 「うす」
lines.english: “Yessir.”

lines.japanese: 俺は重たくなった一輪車を押してきびきび走った。向こうは安全帽をむしり取ってのろのろ歩いてくる。メットの下は生え際の黒い、プリンみたいなツーブロックの茶髪だった。
lines.english: I pushed the heavy wheelbarrow at a brisk run. He ripped off his hard hat and ambled toward me. Beneath it was a brown undercut with dark roots, like the caramel top on a custard pudding.

lines.japanese: すれ違うときに言葉はなかった。向こうが俺に目もくれなかったので、俺は頭を下げずに済んだ。
lines.english: We passed without speaking. He never even looked at me, which spared me the trouble of bowing.

lines.japanese: 「くぁー、きっちー！　ねー、もー、休憩しましょうよ。ヒゲカン、あと二時間ぐらい戻って来ないっすよ」
lines.english: “God, this is brutal! Come on, let's take a break already. Beard Boss won't be back for another two hours.”

lines.japanese: 「マジで？　え、どうする？　誘導のジジイ残して、俺らラーメンでも食い行く？」
lines.english: “Seriously? So what do we do? Leave the old traffic guy here and go get ramen?”

lines.japanese: 監督のおっさんは買い出しにでも行ったんだろうか。プリン頭のガキと数人の同僚たちが、同年代の飛び込みバイトをハブにして（べつにいいけど）サボタージュの計画を練りはじめた。
lines.english: Maybe the foreman had gone to buy supplies. Pudding-head and several coworkers began plotting how to slack off, shutting out the walk-in temp their own age. Fine by me.

lines.japanese: つーか社員いねーのかよ。終わってんな、この現場。
lines.english: Were there no permanent employees here? This site was hopeless.

lines.japanese: 聞こえない振りをするのも面倒だったので、俺は一輪車へ投げおとす廃材の弾道を、ことさら大きく描きつづけた。
lines.english: Pretending not to hear them sounded like work, so I kept lofting debris into the wheelbarrow in extravagantly high arcs.

lines.japanese: ぽーい、がしゃーん。ぽーい、がしゃーん。
lines.english: Toss—*crash*. Toss—*crash*.

lines.japanese: やつらは自分たちの密談（派手な笑い声が混じりはじめた）に夢中で、今度は文句を言ってこなかった。
lines.english: They were too absorbed in their secret conference—now punctuated by bursts of loud laughter—to complain this time.

lines.japanese: 休憩するか否かの会議が、すでに休憩になっている。ガラの悪い座り方で輪を作り、ひたすら寒みー寒みーを連呼する。だったら動け、少しはマシになる。
lines.english: The meeting about whether to take a break had already turned into one. They formed a circle, squatting like thugs, and did nothing but chant *cold, cold, cold*. Then move. You’d warm up.

lines.japanese: そのとき、ふとバリケードの向こう、夜の歩道の人影が目に映った。
lines.english: Just then, a figure on the nighttime sidewalk beyond the barricade caught my eye.

lines.japanese: 難しい字女学院のブレザーに、袖がだぼついてるミニっこい体。締まりのない唇。ふらふらと左右に揺れて落ちつきない、おもちゃ売り場の子供みたいな目玉。
lines.english: A blazer from the girls' school with the impossible name. A tiny body swimming in its sleeves. Slack lips. Eyes roaming restlessly from side to side like a child's in a toy store.

lines.japanese: 「あれ、あいつ……」
lines.english: “Wait, that's...”

lines.japanese: やつだ。ホーメイだかナルだかいう、鳳の妹。
lines.english: It was her. Otori's little sister, Phoenixsong or Naru or whatever.

lines.japanese: こんな時間にこんな場所で、いったい何をしてるんだろう。
lines.english: What was she doing here, in a place like this, at this hour?

lines.japanese: いや、まあ……パルさんとこで聞いた話とあのせわしい首の動きを総合すれば、盗まれたチャリを探してるんだろうことは想像つくけどさ。
lines.english: Well... Between what I'd heard at Paru's and that frantic swivel of her head, it wasn't hard to guess she was looking for the stolen bicycle.

lines.japanese: しかし、あと一時間弱で日付も変わろうという時刻。繁華街から外れているとは言え……いや、だからこそか、若い娘がひとりで無防備だと思う。
lines.english: Still, midnight was less than an hour away. We were outside the entertainment district, true... but perhaps that made a young girl alone here even more vulnerable.

lines.japanese: 真っ赤な背もたれ付きの自転車とやらは、そんなに大事な物なんだろうか。俺は砕けたアスファルトを拾いあつめながら、目の端でやつの様子を追った。
lines.english: Could a bright-red bicycle with a backrest really matter that much? As I gathered broken asphalt, I tracked her from the corner of my eye.

lines.japanese: きょろきょろ、たったった……。
lines.english: Peer, peer. Patter-patter...

lines.japanese: きょろきょろ、たったったった……。
lines.english: Peer, peer. Patter-patter-patter...

lines.japanese: やたらに首を回しながら、あっちへ走って、こっちへ走って……。
lines.english: Craning her head every which way, running over there, then back over here...

lines.japanese: あまりに無駄の多い動き。幅広の歩道はチャリンコがないことぐらい一目瞭然なのに。じっとしていられない性分なんだろうか、すでに挙動不審入ってる。
lines.english: What a waste of motion. One glance was enough to see there were no bicycles on the broad sidewalk. Maybe she was constitutionally incapable of standing still. By now she looked actively suspicious.

lines.japanese: 「成田ぁ！　てめ、ボケッとしてんじゃねーぞ！」
lines.english: “Narita! Quit spacing out!”

lines.japanese: 憩いの車座から催促が飛んできた。しまった、いつの間にか動きが鈍っていたらしい。
lines.english: A call to hurry came from their cozy little circle. Damn. Apparently I had slowed down without noticing.

lines.japanese: 俺は頼れる先輩方に頭を下げたあと、視界のすみをチラついていた小っこい影にケツを向けた。他人の心配をしてる場合じゃなかった。
lines.english: I bowed to my dependable elders, then turned my ass on the tiny shadow flickering at the edge of my vision. I was in no position to worry about a stranger.

lines.japanese: 自分の身は自分で守ろう。俺も、やつも、もちろんおまえもだ。俺は落ちた稲穂を拾う婆さんみたいに腰を折って、散らばった廃材を拾いはじめた。
lines.english: Everyone had to look after themselves. Me, her, and yes, you too. Bent double like an old woman gleaning fallen rice, I resumed gathering the scattered debris.

lines.japanese: ところでさ、もし俺がこの欠片ひとつひとつを並べなおしてパズルみたいにくっつけたら、また元の道路に戻ったりするのかね。はん。無理だろ。
lines.english: Suppose I laid every fragment back in place and fitted them together like a jigsaw puzzle. Would they become the original road again? Hah. Of course not.

lines.japanese: 「成田ぁー！　次こっちなー！」
lines.english: “Narita! Over here next!”

lines.japanese: 「ぅいーっす」
lines.english: “Yessiiir.”

lines.japanese: だみ声で素直に応じた。いつもの「ブッ殺すぞ」が言えないんだから仕方ない。
lines.english: I answered obediently in a gravelly voice. My customary *I’ll fucking kill you, asshole* was unavailable, so what choice did I have?
“Whew...”

lines.japanese: すでに一輪車は満載状態だ。俺は背筋を伸ばして一息つけた。投光機の不健康な照明の下で、俺は全身の関節を軽くほぐした。
lines.english: The wheelbarrow was already loaded to the brim. I straightened my back and caught my breath. Beneath the floodlights' sickly glare, I worked the stiffness from every joint.

lines.japanese: 上半身を１２０度ひねって腰を鳴らしたとき、またあいつの姿が視界に入った。
lines.english: As I twisted my upper body a hundred and twenty degrees and cracked my lower back, she entered my field of vision again.

lines.japanese: やつはきょとんと口を開けて立ちどまっていた。その視線が待つ先に、一台のクルマがハザードを点滅させてゆっくり滑りこんでくる。
lines.english: She had stopped with her mouth hanging open in blank surprise. A car glided slowly toward the spot she was staring at, hazard lights blinking.

lines.japanese: ごてごてエアロパーツときらきらアルミホイールで飾ったアメリカンな白ワゴン。ズゥーンズゥーンと漏れる低音。スモークガラスの奥でインテリアがブルーに光ってる。恥ずかしいぐらいヤンキー趣味丸出しだ。
lines.english: A white American van smothered in a body kit and glittering alloy wheels. Bass leaked out in a steady *thoom, thoom*. The interior glowed blue behind smoked glass. Its delinquent aesthetic was shameless enough to embarrass anyone looking at it.

lines.japanese: 数人分のはしゃぎ声を車中に残して、運転席のドアから「いかにも」なのがひとり降りてきた。
lines.english: Leaving several excited voices inside, one unmistakable specimen climbed out of the driver's seat.

lines.japanese: 「なんだァ……？」
lines.english: “What the...?”

lines.japanese: 降りてきたのはガタイのいいスキンヘッド。無闇にでかい図体をオーバーサイズのパーカーに包んだＢボーイスタイル。ＢはブラックとかバッドボーイとかブレイキンのＢ。年頃のデブはすぐそういうのに憧れる。
lines.english: A big, heavily built skinhead emerged, his needlessly massive frame wrapped in an oversized hoodie. B-boy style—the B stood for Black, bad boy, or breaking. Fat young men were quick to dream in that direction.

lines.japanese: 繁華街のはずれ、無防備な少女に言いよる悪漢。呆れるぐらい予想を裏切らない街だった。
lines.english: The edge of the entertainment district. A villain accosting a defenseless girl. This town lived up to expectations with almost insulting precision.

lines.japanese: 「あーあ、言わんこっちゃねー」
lines.english: “Haaah. I knew it.”

lines.japanese: しかし、あのお嬢には身を持って危険を知ってもらういい機会だ。どのみちナンパのひとつやふたつ軽くあしらえるようでなければ、夜の柳木原へデビューするにはまだ早い。
lines.english: Still, this was a fine opportunity for the sheltered girl to learn about danger firsthand. If she couldn't brush off a pickup attempt or two, she wasn't ready to make her Yanagihara-after-dark debut.

lines.japanese: まあ、いざとなればあの小娘には切り札がある。兄貴の名前という最強カード。あのデブ共、あんなクルマ転がして粋がってる連中なら、この街のカリスマたる鳳翔を知らないはずはない。
lines.english: And if things got serious, she had the ultimate trump card: her brother’s name. Punks strutting around in a van like that could hardly be ignorant of Kakeru Otori, the reigning icon of this town.

lines.japanese: あ、いや……だからこそ鳳翔には敵も多かろう。ヘタに名前を出せば逆効果になる可能性もあるか……。
lines.english: Though... perhaps that was exactly why Otori had so many enemies. Carelessly dropping his name could have the opposite effect...

lines.japanese: 「成田てめ、手ェ止まってんぞボケ！　休憩すんならネコ端に寄せとけ！」
lines.english: “Narita, your hands stopped, dumbass! If you’re taking a break, move the wheelbarrow aside!”

lines.japanese: 「あ……うっす」
lines.english: “Ah... Yessir.”

lines.japanese: 言われたとおり、俺は一輪車のグリップを掴んでその場を離れようとした。そのとき視界のすみで、あのホーメイだかナルだかの小さな体がよろめいた。ハゲのぶっとい腕に捕まったみたいだ。
lines.english: As ordered, I took hold of the wheelbarrow and started to leave. At the edge of my vision, the tiny body belonging to Phoenixsong or Naru stumbled. Baldy's thick arm appeared to have caught her.

lines.japanese: 「あん？」
lines.english: “Hm?”

lines.japanese: なんだありゃ。ナンパにしちゃ強引な手口だな。
lines.english: What was that? That’s awfully pushy for a pickup.

lines.japanese: やつらはおもちゃ売り場の親子みたいに引っぱり合いをしていたが、やがて小娘の方が大男を振りほどき、１８０度くるっと向きを変えて駆けだす。
lines.english: They tugged back and forth like a parent and child in a toy store. At last the girl tore free of the giant, spun a full hundred and eighty degrees, and ran.

lines.japanese: 逃げる背中を指差して、ハゲは余裕たっぷりに笑っていた。窓越しの仲間たちに下品な冗談でも飛ばしているのだろうか。見ろよおまえら、あの嬢ちゃん逃げられるとでも思ってやがるぜグヘヘ……。
lines.english: Pointing after her, Baldy laughed with perfect confidence. Presumably he was tossing some filthy joke through the window to his companions. *Look, boys. Little miss thinks she can get away. Heh heh heh...*

lines.japanese: 「……え、ヤバいじゃん」
lines.english: “...Wait. This is bad.”

lines.japanese: 俺が落ちついて焦っているうちにも、ハゲは歩幅の違いを見せつけるような速度で悠々あとを追いはじめた。さらにはワゴンからもう二人ばかり降りてくる。
lines.english: Even as I panicked with remarkable composure, Baldy set off after her at a leisurely pace that still advertised the difference in their strides. Two more men climbed out of the van.

lines.japanese: 「まじかよハァァァ……」
lines.english: “Seriously? Haaah...”

lines.japanese: 俺はえぐられたアスファルトの底へ長い長い溜息を吐きおとしてから、仕方ない、諦めてこぶしを握りこんだ。
lines.english: I dropped a long, long sigh into the gouged asphalt. Then, resigned to my fate, I clenched my fists.

lines.japanese: くそっ、鳳の関係者（それも肉親！）となんか関わりたくないのに、よりによって俺の目の前で危機一髪を見せつけるなんてアノヤロウ、嫌がらせとしか思えない。
lines.english: Goddammit. I wanted nothing to do with anyone connected to Otori—least of all a blood relative. And this bastard had chosen to stage a life-or-death crisis right in front of me. It could only be deliberate harassment.

lines.japanese: 俺は急いで一輪車を脇へ寄せ、呑気にあぐらをかいているプリンたちの元へ走った。
lines.english: I hurriedly rolled the wheelbarrow aside and ran toward the pudding-heads sitting cross-legged without a care.

lines.japanese: 「サーセンあの、便所行っていいすか」
lines.english: “S'cuse me. Can I go to the bathroom?”

lines.japanese: やつらは近所のラーメン屋のバイトねーちゃんが処女なのか処女じゃないのかでケンケンゴーゴー盛りあがっていた。ひとりが面倒くさそうに顔を上げた。
lines.english: They were deep in a furious debate over whether the girl working at a nearby ramen shop was a virgin. One of them looked up as though I had inconvenienced him.

lines.japanese: 「あァ～？　さあ、いんじゃん、知んねーけど」
lines.english: “Huh? Sure, whatever. Hell if I know.”

lines.japanese: 「うす」
lines.english: “Yessir.”

lines.japanese: 連中がくだらない談議を再開させるのと同時に、俺は１１０ｍハードル走さながら、オレンジ色のバリケードを飛びこえ車道を走っていた。
lines.english: The moment they resumed their pointless debate, I vaulted the orange barricades and sprinted into the road like a 110-meter hurdler.

lines.japanese: 迫りくる大型トラックが、唐突に踊りでた人影へ猛烈なハイビームとクラクションを浴びせかける。
lines.english: A huge truck bore down on the figure that had suddenly danced into its path, high beams blazing and horn blaring.

lines.japanese: 「っせえよ、いちいち騒ぐな」
lines.english: “Shut up. Don't make a production out of everything.”

lines.japanese: 俺は躊躇なく駆けぬけ、二車線分を一気に突っきった。ガードレールの支柱に片手を貼りつけ、助走の勢いがついたまま、ひらり──
lines.english: Without hesitation I tore across two lanes, planted one hand on a guardrail post, and—still carrying all the momentum of my run—sailed lightly—

lines.japanese: 「毎度ー、成田工務店です」
lines.english: “Evening. Narita Construction, at your service.”

lines.japanese: ──飛びこえ、歩道のはたに着地した。ぶおん！　車道をカッ飛んでゆくトラックが、俺の背中に轟音とガスくさい烈風を叩きつけていった。
lines.english: —over it to land at the edge of the sidewalk. *Vwoom!* The truck thundered past, lashing my back with a roaring gale that stank of exhaust.

lines.japanese: 「んあ？　なんだあ？」
lines.english: “Huh? What’s this?”

lines.japanese: 「あれー、えー、なんでドラさ～ん？」
lines.english: “Oh? Um, why are you here, Dora?”

lines.japanese: 駅まで送るの送らないのと綱引き状態だった両軍が、はたと動きを止めて口を開いた。どちらも気の抜けるような声だった。
lines.english: The two sides, locked in a tug-of-war over whether she would accept a ride to the station, stopped dead and opened their mouths. All the air went out of both voices.

lines.japanese: 「あー、取り込み中ちょっとゴメンナサイ。ああ俺、この女の関係者」
lines.english: “Sorry to interrupt. I'm with this girl.”

lines.japanese: 自己紹介しながらずかずか割って入ってゆき、ホーメイだか何だかいう小娘の肩にがっちり腕をまわした。
lines.english: As I introduced myself, I barged between them and locked one arm firmly around the shoulders of the girl named Phoenixsong or whatever.
“What!?”

lines.japanese: 「そんで、俺はこいつを駅まで送ってきたいんだけど、そっちの用件はなに」
lines.english: “And I'm taking her to the station. What did you people want?”

lines.japanese: 女を強引に引きよせ、少しばかり強気な態度を見せてやると、男たちは目を丸くしてうろたえた。
lines.english: I hauled her toward me and showed them a little aggression. The men's eyes widened, their composure wavering.

lines.japanese: 「え……あれ、いや……」
lines.english: “Uh... well, no...”

lines.japanese: 「なに。ないの。用ないなら、もう行くけど」
lines.english: “What? Nothing? If you don't need anything, we'll be going.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、ああ……まあ、いいけど……」
lines.english: “Ah, yeah... sure, I guess...”

lines.japanese: 「そう。じゃおやすみ。歯ァ磨けよ」
lines.english: “Good. Then good night. Brush your teeth.”
“Y-yeah—”

lines.japanese: 「──じゃねえや！　エイヨー、ワッツァップ成田君！　なんだよ、こんなところでメイクマネーかよ」
lines.english: “—Wait, no! Ayo, what's up, Narita! You out here making money?”
“...What?”

lines.japanese: なぜか不良Ａは俺の名を知っていた。
lines.english: For some reason, Delinquent A knew my name.

lines.japanese: 「ホリィシット！　こいつぁビビッたぜ、おどかしやがってファッキン・マイメン！」
lines.english: “Holy shit! You scared me, fuckin' my man!”

lines.japanese: しかも不良Ａは気安かった。
lines.english: Delinquent A was also much too familiar.

lines.japanese: 「ぶはー成田っちじゃー！　ヤーマン、お久しぶりぶり一服いっとく～？」
lines.english: “Bwah! It's Narita! Ya man, long time no see! Want a little something to smoke?”

lines.japanese: あとから出てきた不良Ｂも気安かった。
lines.english: Delinquent B emerged behind him, equally familiar.

lines.japanese: 「むぁーじスか！　ちょ隼人先ぱ～い、あんた俺の行く先々で待・ち・ぶ・せ・てんじゃねーっ？」
lines.english: “Seriously!? Hayato! Come on, are you lying in wait everywhere I go?”

lines.japanese: つーか、どいつもこいつも気安かった。
lines.english: Every last one of them was much too familiar.

lines.japanese: つーか……こいつら……だったのか……。
lines.english: Wait... These were *those* people...?

lines.japanese: た、助けに来て損した……くそ、だって俺、いちいちザコＡだのＢだのの顔なんて見ねーもんよ……。
lines.english: I-I had wasted my time coming to help... Dammit, it wasn't as if I bothered memorizing the faces of every random small fry...

lines.japanese: 「♪いきなし車道からお出ましのファルコン！　わりかしサプライズそれマジで勘弁！」
lines.english: “♪ Falcon flies in from the traffic lane! / Surprise like that will drive a brother insane!”

lines.japanese: 「いいから。いちいち手マイクでフリースタイルラップとか始めなくていいから」
lines.english: “Enough. You don't have to turn your fist into a microphone and start freestyling every time.”

lines.japanese: 「まったく想像してみろよ。たとえばあんたが女房とハメハメしてるとき、いきなり道路工事のあんちゃんに声をかけられたらどうなる。間違いなく中でチビっちまうさ。さては成田君、そういう趣味があるのかい」
lines.english: “Use your imagination. Suppose you're banging your wife and some roadworker suddenly calls out to you. You'd come inside her from the shock, guaranteed. Is that your particular kink, Narita?”

lines.japanese: キャラは強烈だから、口さえ開けばすぐ分かっちゃうのがまた……。
lines.english: Their personalities were so overpowering that I recognized them the instant they opened their mouths. Which somehow made it worse...

lines.japanese: 「あれー？　ドラさんと左右田さんたち、お知り合いだったんですかー？」
lines.english: “Oh? Dora, you know Mr. Souda and his friends?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、全然」
lines.english: “Never met them.”

lines.japanese: 俺は思わず嘘をついた。
lines.english: I lied without even thinking.

lines.japanese: 「ダーム！　なにワックなこと言いやがるんだファッキンガイ、不倫の末の破局カップルじゃあるめえし、そんな楽しかったメモリーズまで消しちまうような悲しい嘘はやめてくれよ」
lines.english: “Damn! Don't come at me with that wack shit, fuckin' guy. We ain't some couple splitting after an affair. Don't tell a sad lie that erases all our beautiful memories together.”

lines.japanese: 「さ、さあ。どちら様でしたか……」
lines.english: “I-I couldn't say. Who are you, again...?”

lines.japanese: 「ぶはー、なんて薄情な！　ノーマン、しゃーない思いだしてもらいましょかー」
lines.english: “Bwah, how heartless! Norman, looks like we'll have to jog his memory.”

lines.japanese: 「おっ、アレ行くの？　行っちゃう系？　行っちゃいます的展開～！？」
lines.english: “Oh, are we doing that? We going there? Is this where we totally go there!?”

lines.japanese: やつらはニヤけた顔を突きあわせると、大きく一回頷いた。そして──
lines.english: They pressed their grinning faces together and gave one deep nod. Then—

lines.japanese: 「ウィーアー……！」
lines.english: “We are...!”

lines.japanese: <10>\「ヤナギハラ！　フレイム！　バァァァーズ！」
lines.english: “Yanagihara! Flame! Biiiiiirds!”

lines.japanese: ──なにをとち狂ったか、各々自分の上着をまくったり開いたりして、その下の白いＴシャツを露出した。
lines.english: —for reasons beyond sanity, each man hoisted or opened his jacket to expose the white shirt beneath.

lines.japanese: 奇天烈な光景に、俺は思わず眉根を寄せて見入ってしまう。
lines.english: Faced with this bizarre spectacle, I knitted my brows and found myself staring.

lines.japanese: 全員おそろいの白いロンＴ。どれも腹の真ん中には、炎の輪に縁取られたニワトリって感じの、ひとをナメくさった絵柄がプリントされていた。
lines.english: They all wore matching white long-sleeved T-shirts, each with the same insolent design plastered across the stomach: something like a chicken framed by a ring of fire.

lines.japanese: 「……なにそれ」
lines.english: “...What is that?”

lines.japanese: 「ＹＦＢ　Ｔシャツ！」
lines.english: “The YFB T-shirt!”

lines.japanese: 「作んなよ」
lines.english: “Don't make those.”

lines.japanese: 「来月のメンフリにも載るよ！」
lines.english: “We're gonna be in next month's *Men's Freeze*, too!”

lines.japanese: 「載せんなよ」
lines.english: “Don’t get yourselves featured.”

lines.japanese: 「今度のバージョンは皇帝のサイン入り！」
lines.english: “The next version comes with the Emperor's autograph!”

lines.japanese: 「入れんなよ。つか、前のバージョンあんのかよ」
lines.english: “Don't put that on it. Wait—there was a previous version?”

lines.japanese: つか、端から順に個別ツッコミさせんなよ。
lines.english: And quit making me go down the line with a comeback for every single one of you.

lines.japanese: 「どうしたんですかードラさん、ものっそい疲れた顔してますけど」
lines.english: “What's wrong, Dora? You look incredibly exhausted.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、するだろ」
lines.english: “Of course I do.”

lines.japanese: 「あらら、一服いっとく～？」
lines.english: “Oh, dear. Want a little something to smoke?”

lines.japanese: 「はいはい、もういいから。整列、整列。早くしまえソレ、おー、服ちゃんと着るー」
lines.english: “Yes, yes. That's enough. Form a line. Put those away. Come on, everybody get dressed properly.”

lines.japanese: 俺は仕切りなおした。
lines.english: I started over.

lines.japanese: 「いいか、てめーら。あんな、こっちは仕事中なんだよ。タラタラやってる余裕はねーの。な、ちったあキンチョー感持てキンチョー感」
lines.english: “Listen, all of you. I'm in the middle of a job. I don't have time to stand around. Show some urgency, would you? Just a little urgency.”

lines.japanese: 「でー。なんだおまえら、なんなんだ、えェ？　紛らわしンだよ、ひとさらいの決定的瞬間にしか見えなかったじゃねえか。こんなとこでアタマ弱いのが寄りあつまって何してたんだコノヤロウ」
lines.english: “Now. What the hell were you doing? Huh? You made it look exactly like I'd caught a kidnapping in progress. What's this flock of idiots doing gathered out here, anyway?”

lines.japanese: 俺は小娘を含むその場の全員に、問い詰め口調で言った。
lines.english: I interrogated everyone present, the girl included.

lines.japanese: 「はあ、えーと、今まさにあのワンボックスカーへむりやり引きずりこまれようとしていました」
lines.english: “Well, um, they were in fact just attempting to drag me forcibly into that van.”
“...What?”

lines.japanese: 「Ｗａｉｔ！　ウェイ、ウェイ、ステイクールだぜ成田君、リアルを見究めようぜ。たしかにその通りだが、べつにヘンな意味じゃねえんだ」
lines.english: “Wait! Wait, wait, stay cool, Narita. Take a hard look at reality. What she said is technically true, but we didn't mean anything weird by it.”

lines.japanese: 「そーそー！　女の子が夜中にひとりでオンモ歩いてちゃ危ないでしょ？　だから、おにいさんたちがブーブーで送ったげるって言っただけ！」
lines.english: “Right, right! It's dangerous for a girl to walk around alone at night, isn't it? We only said we'd give her a ride home!”

lines.japanese: 容疑者たちはそう供述した。俺はやつらに目を据えたまま、肩だけホーメイ側に傾けて確認した。
lines.english: So testified the suspects. Keeping my eyes fixed on them, I tipped only my shoulder toward Phoenixsong for confirmation.

lines.japanese: 「本当か」
lines.english: “That true?”

lines.japanese: 「えーと、はい、本当ですけどぉー」
lines.english: “Um, yes, it's true, but...”

lines.japanese: 女は不満げに肯定した。その返答に男たちが「ほらな？」と顎を反らす。
lines.english: She confirmed it unhappily. At her answer, the men tipped up their chins: *See?*

lines.japanese: 「でもしつこいんですよー。私、結構ですって必死に抵抗してるのに、すぐだからすぐだから気持ちいいからなどと言って、力ずくでむりやりー」
lines.english: “But they won't take no for an answer. I'm resisting for all I'm worth and telling them I'm fine, and they keep saying it'll be quick and it'll feel good, and trying to force me—”

lines.japanese: 「本当か」
lines.english: “That true?”

lines.japanese: 今度は男たちに聞いた。
lines.english: This time I asked the men.

lines.japanese: 「えーと、まあ、ほんとッスけどー」
lines.english: “Uh, well, that's true, but...”

lines.japanese: やつらは不満げに肯定した。その返答にホーメイが「ほらー」と顎を反らす。
lines.english: They confirmed it unhappily. At their answer, Phoenixsong tipped up her chin: *See?*

lines.japanese: 「いや、でも、すぐ着くって言っただけだぜ？　家まですぐ着くって。んーな、あんたが想像するよーなヘンなことぁ言ってねーっすよ」
lines.english: “No, but all I said was we'd get there quick. Get her home quick. I never said anything weird like whatever you're imagining.”

lines.japanese: 「そーそー。ふかふかシートで気持ちいいからーって言っただけだよお？」
lines.english: “Right, right. All I said was the soft, fluffy seats would feel good.”

lines.japanese: 「そーそー。おとなしくしてなリトルビッチさもなきゃあんたの可愛いお口に黒くて硬くてエキサイティングな栓をすることになっちまうぞと言っただけだぜー？」
lines.english: “Right, right. I only told the little bitch to behave herself, or we'd have to plug her pretty mouth with something black and hard and exciting.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、言ってんじゃんヘンなこと。約一名、全力で言ってんじゃん」
lines.english: “You *did* say something weird. One of you went all in.”

lines.japanese: 「ああもう、ＬＲは自分の口にエキサイティングな栓しててよ！」
lines.english: “Oh, honestly, LR. Put an exciting plug in your own mouth!”

lines.japanese: 「Ｕｍｍ、すまねえ、ついロスにいた頃のノリでうっかりクールが過ぎちまった……分かった。しばらく俺は、この街ギバラじゃ死んだマグロみてえに麗しくしてるぜ」
lines.english: “Mmm, my apologies. I slipped back into the vibe from my Los Angeles days and became a little too cool... Understood. For a while, I shall remain beautiful as a dead tuna here in Gibara.”

lines.japanese: 「つーか、おまえら仮にも不良だろ。なんかウソくさいんだよな……わざわざこんな小娘に親切してやる必要あんのかよ」
lines.english: “Anyway, you're supposed to be delinquents. Something about this doesn't ring true. Why go out of your way to help some little girl?”

lines.japanese: 「あるよ！　だって皇帝の妹じゃん」
lines.english: “We have to! She's the Emperor's sister.”

lines.japanese: 「あのひと表向き、俺は家族を捨てたーとか言ってるけど、もしナルタローに万一のことでもあったら、ぜってー俺らタダじゃ済まないよね……」
lines.english: “He goes around saying he’s disowned his family and all, but if anything happened to Narutaro, there’s no way we’d get off easy...”

lines.japanese: 「あー、そういうアレな」
lines.english: “Ah. So that's the angle.”

lines.japanese: 俺は後ろ頭をがしがし掻いた。
lines.english: I scratched hard at the back of my head.

lines.japanese: 「ヨウ、とにかく成田君、事情はどうあれ、ひとつだけ確かなトゥルースがあるぜ。何かって？　決まってるだろ、こんな時間にか弱いガールひとりにさせちゃいけねえってことさ」
lines.english: “Yo, whatever the circumstances, Narita, one truth remains. What is it, you ask? Come on, man: a frail girl shouldn’t be alone at this hour.”

lines.japanese: 「け、結構ですー。もー、ほっといてくださいー」
lines.english: “N-no, thank you. Please just leave me alone.”

lines.japanese: ホーメイが俺の陰に隠れながら、えいっえいっと、ひょろけたワンツーを繰りだす。ハゲの言うことはもっともだが、この小娘はまだチャリンコ探しを続けるつもりのようだ。
lines.english: Phoenixsong hid behind me, throwing an unsteady little one-two around my side. Baldy had a point, but apparently the girl still intended to continue searching for her bicycle.
“Haaah...”

lines.japanese: 面倒なことに首を突っこんでしまった。早くバイトに戻りたい。
lines.english: I had stuck my neck into a mess. I wanted to get back to work.

lines.japanese: 「ドラさんドラさん、たすけてください。お引き取り願ってください」
lines.english: “Dora, Dora, please help me. Ask them to go away.”

lines.japanese: 「願ったら引き取ってくれんの」
lines.english: “You think they'll leave if I ask nicely?”

lines.japanese: 俺はぐったりとハゲたちを見た。だが気の抜けた半目を、やつらは敵意みなぎる眼光と勘違いしたようだ。
lines.english: I gave the bald men a weary stare. Apparently they mistook my exhausted, half-lidded eyes for a glare blazing with hostility.

lines.japanese: 「な、なんだよ、やる気かよ……」
lines.english: “Wh-what? You wanna fight?”

lines.japanese: 「やんねーよ」
lines.english: “No.”

lines.japanese: 「くそう、あの目は本気だな……」
lines.english: “Dammit. Those eyes mean business...”

lines.japanese: 「だから、やんねーっての」
lines.english: “I just said no.”

lines.japanese: 「やべえぜ、一触即発とはまさにこのことだ……」
lines.english: “Damn. This is the very definition of a hair-trigger standoff...”

lines.japanese: 「やんねーつってんだろテメ、高速道路の柱に半身埋めてそこそこ神秘的なオブジェにすんぞコノヤロウ共」
lines.english: “I said I'm not fighting. Keep it up and I'll bury you halfway into an expressway pillar and turn you into a moderately mystical monument, assholes.”

lines.japanese: 「聞け。あんな？　なんで俺らが、この小娘のために戦わなきゃなんねーんだよ。本人が帰りたくないっつってんだ、ほっとけほっとけ。大人の心配受けいれねーようなガキぁ、犯されようが殺されようが自己責任だ」
lines.english: “Listen. Why should we have to fight over this girl? She says she doesn't want to go home, so leave her alone. A brat who refuses an adult's concern has only herself to blame if she gets raped or murdered.”

lines.japanese: 「いいや、そいつは無責任が過ぎるぜマザファッキン成田、それを言っちゃあ身もカバーもねえよ」
lines.english: “No, motherfuckin' Narita, that's taking irresponsibility much too far. Talk like that and there ain't no body or cover left.”

lines.japanese: 「ていうか？　ア～イちょっと待って～？　たしか成田っち、最初になんか言ってなかったっけ……」
lines.english: “Wait a minute. Didn't Narita say something when he first got here...?”

lines.japanese: 「あッ！　そーだ言ってた！　このひと『こいつを駅まで送ってきたいんだけど』って言ってた！」
lines.english: “Ah! Right, he did! He said, ‘I'm taking her to the station’!”

lines.japanese: ギャル男が叫んだ直後──
lines.english: The instant the flashy kid shouted—
“Huh?”
“What?”

lines.japanese: <10>\「ザッツグッド！」
lines.english: “That's good!”

lines.japanese: ──三方から同時に声が起こった。
lines.english: —three voices rose at once from three directions.

lines.japanese: 「え……うそ、俺そんなこと言ったっけ」
lines.english: “Wait... Seriously? Did I say that?”

lines.japanese: <8>「てめバックレんじゃねえよブッ殺すぞコノヤロウ」
lines.english: “Don't play dumb, asshole. We'll kill you.”

lines.japanese: 「……そんな、ハモることねーじゃん」
lines.english: “...You didn't have to say it in harmony.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、偉い！　やっぱ隼人先輩マジ男だわ、マジ惚れるわ。んじゃあ、とりま・よろまーっす！」
lines.english: “Dude, respect! Hayato, you're a real man. I could seriously fall for you. 'Kaythen—countin' on yaaa!”

lines.japanese: 「やーです！　私まだ帰りませんよー！」
lines.english: “No! I'm not going home yet!”

lines.japanese: 「おいおい、リスペクト・ヨァセルフだぜえリルシスタ。この街ギバラで生きてくなら、もっと自分を大切にしなきゃいけねえよ」
lines.english: “Come on, li'l sister. Respect yourself. If you're gonna survive here in Gibara, you gotta take better care of yourself.”

lines.japanese: 「そーそー。成田っちみたいな優秀なボディーガードに守ってもらえるなんて、ナルタロー幸運よー？」
lines.english: “Right, right. Narutaro, you're lucky to have a bodyguard as excellent as Narita!”

lines.japanese: 「ま、もっとも成田君といやあ、生まれた瞬間振りかえって母親のアソコをナメナメしたことで評判のクレイジーベイブだ。果たして本当に幸運といえるやらククク」
lines.english: “Though this *is* Narita—the crazy baby famous for turning around the moment he was born and licking his mother's... Well, whether that makes you lucky, heh heh...”

lines.japanese: 「ああもう！　バニィＤ、この駄豚の口ちゃんと塞いどいてよ！」
lines.english: “Oh, enough! Bunny D, plug this filthy pig's mouth properly!”

lines.japanese: 「いい、いい、俺がやる。俺にやらせろ。むしろ口と同時に、鼻穴ダブルでいかせろ」
lines.english: “No, no, I'll do it. Let me. In fact, let me take his mouth and both nostrils at once.”

lines.japanese: 「アァーウチ！　あい痛たたたた、イッツァ、ジョーク！　イッツァ、ギャングスタ・ジョォォォーク！」
lines.english: “Owww! Ow-ow-ow-ow! It's a joke! It's a gangsta joooke!”

lines.japanese: 「どあーッ！　ちょ、隼人先輩！　んなことより後ろ後ろ！」
lines.english: “Whoa! Hayato, never mind that—behind you!”
“Huh?”

lines.japanese: ブタの鼻をねじったまま振りかえる。
lines.english: Still twisting the pig's nose, I looked back.

lines.japanese: 混乱の戦場から、ちんまい制服姿が抜き足ですすすーっとフェードアウトしかけていた。
lines.english: A tiny figure in a school uniform was tiptoeing smoothly out of the battlefield, trying to fade from view.

lines.japanese: 「いや、とりあえず待て」
lines.english: “No. Just wait.”
“Nooo!”

lines.japanese: 背後から襟首を抑えても、やつはまだ先へ進もうと四肢をばたつかせていた。
lines.english: Even with me holding the back of her collar, she kept flailing all four limbs in an effort to advance.

lines.japanese: 「左右田さーん、たすけてくださーい、おおお、犯されるーう」
lines.english: “Mr. Soudaaa, help meee! Ohhh, I’m gonna get raped!”

lines.japanese: 今度は俺じゃない方に救いを求めてる。冗談みたいな変わり身の早さだ。
lines.english: Now she was appealing to the other side to save her. The speed of her defection was almost comic.

lines.japanese: 「じゃ、じゃあ成田っち！　あとよろしくね！」
lines.english: “W-well, Narita! We'll leave the rest to you!”

lines.japanese: 「ピース・ア～ウ！」
lines.english: “Peace ouuut!”

lines.japanese: ずざ、ずざ、ずざっと、フレイムバーズ御一行があとずさってゆく。
lines.english: *Scrape, scrape, scrape.* The entire Flame Birds delegation shuffled backward.

lines.japanese: 「いや、ちょーちょーちょー、待てって。マジ困るって、こんなん任されたっておまえ……」
lines.english: “Whoa, wait, wait, wait. Seriously, I'm in trouble here. You can't just dump this on me...”

lines.japanese: 「そんじゃそーゆーことでっ！」
lines.english: “Then it's settled!”

lines.japanese: <15>「そーゆーことでっ！」
lines.english: “It's settled!”

lines.japanese: そしてやつらはヤンキーワゴンに駆けもどり、めたくそ鬼発進で夜の彼方へ走りだしていった。
lines.english: They raced back to the delinquent van and peeled out savagely into the night.
“W-wait...”

lines.japanese: 「だから……ハモんなって……」
lines.english: “And stop... saying things in harmony...”

lines.japanese: 取りのこされた俺は、みるみる小さくなってゆくテールランプに届くはずもない手を伸ばし、聞こえるはずもないつぶやきをこぼしていた。
lines.english: Left behind, I stretched one futile hand toward the rapidly shrinking taillights and murmured words they could never hear.

lines.japanese: 「つか俺、リアルにバイト中なんですけど……」
lines.english: “I'm literally in the middle of a shift...”

lines.japanese: 長いトイレになりそうだった。
lines.english: This was shaping up to be one long bathroom break.

lines.japanese: くそっ。これだから鳳やその身内に関わっちゃいけないんだ。
lines.english: Dammit. This was exactly why you never got involved with Otori or his relatives.

lines.japanese: 「えー、それでは私もそういうことでー」
lines.english: “Well, then, I'll be going too.”

lines.japanese: 「だから」
lines.english: “That's what I mean.”

lines.japanese: さりげなく逃げようとした騒動の元を引きよせる。
lines.english: I hauled back the source of the commotion as she made a casual bid for escape.

lines.japanese: 「もうほんと勘弁して。これ以上、事態悪化させないで」
lines.english: “Seriously, give me a break. Don't make this any worse.”

lines.japanese: 「あああー、離してくださいー」
lines.english: “Aaah. Please release me.”

lines.japanese: 離したいのは山々だが、しかし、次にこいつの「心配」をするやつがまた鳳の仲間だとは限らない。ふとブルーテント住まいのトメさんに聞いた、未必の故意という言葉が脳裏をよぎる。
lines.english: I wanted nothing more than to let go. But the next person to show her ‘concern’ might not belong to Otori's crowd. A phrase I had once heard from Tome, who lived beneath a blue tarp, crossed my mind: conditional intent.

lines.japanese: たとえば、酒に酔いつぶれて眠りこけたやつを真冬の道端に放置して、もしそいつが凍死した場合、見捨てた方は罪に問われるって話。
lines.english: His example was leaving someone passed-out drunk by the roadside in the dead of winter. If the man froze to death, the person who abandoned him could be held responsible.

lines.japanese: 「ぶれいくー、ぶれいくー」
lines.english: “Break. Break.”

lines.japanese: ホーメイは俺の苦労も知らず、めいっぱい伸ばした両手の指先でガードレールをぺたぺた触っていた。
lines.english: Oblivious to my difficulties, Phoenixsong stretched both arms as far as they would go and patted the guardrail with her fingertips.

lines.japanese: 「あーもー、世話かけんな。行くぞ」
lines.english: “Ahh, enough. Stop making trouble. We're going.”

lines.japanese: 俺は駅の方角──夜空に切りたったネオンサインの数々を遠くに望んだ。
lines.english: I looked toward the station, where distant neon signs rose like sheer cliffs against the night sky.

lines.japanese: その明かりのド真ん中を目指して、俺は片手で掴んだ小娘の襟首を、夜道にかざすランタンのごとく突きだして歩きはじめた。
lines.english: Aiming for the heart of that light, I set off with the girl's collar clutched in one hand, holding her before me like a lantern on a dark road.

lines.japanese: 「あのー」
ランタンが前方０．５メートルから窺うように声を発した。
lines.english: The lantern spoke tentatively from half a meter ahead.

lines.japanese: 「なに」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 「せめてこの手を離していただけませんか」
lines.english: “Could you at least let go of me?”

lines.japanese: 「離したら逃げんだろ」
lines.english: “You'll run if I do.”

lines.japanese: 「逃げません。鳳鳴の名において」
lines.english: “I will not. I swear it on the name of Naru Otori.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、そ」
lines.english: “That so?”

lines.japanese: ためしに俺は、やつを野に放ってみた。
lines.english: As an experiment, I released her into the wild.

lines.japanese: 「へへー、こいつぁとんだ甘ちゃんだぜー」
lines.english: “Heh heh. What a hopeless sucker.”

lines.japanese: 案の定、やつはいきなり走りだした。いいスタートダッシュだった。
lines.english: As expected, she bolted without warning. A fine start off the blocks.

lines.japanese: がしっ。
lines.english: *Grab.*

lines.japanese: 負けじと走り、とっ捕まえる。
lines.english: Refusing to be beaten, I ran too and caught her.

lines.japanese: 「てめ、逃げねえつったじゃねえかよ」
lines.english: “You said you wouldn't run.”
“...Oh. Did I?”

lines.japanese: 「うわー、ドラさんいい脚してますねー」
lines.english: “Wow, Dora. You have very good legs.”

lines.japanese: それは一年前、おまえの兄貴にも言われた。嫌なこと思いださせんな、クソ妹。
lines.english: Your brother had told me the same thing a year ago. Don't remind me of unpleasant memories, shitty little sister.

lines.japanese: 「つか、おまえも意外に脚速ええのな」
lines.english: “You're surprisingly fast yourself.”

lines.japanese: 意外でもないか。口開けてポーッとしてばっかいるけど、首や手足ははしっこく動いている。
lines.english: Perhaps it shouldn’t have surprised me. She spent most of her time staring blankly with her mouth open, but her neck and limbs were always darting around.

lines.japanese: 「あー私、体育の成績いいんですよー。短距離走は特にあのー、元陸上部ですんでー」
lines.english: “Oh, I get good marks in PE. Especially sprinting. I used to be on the track team.”

lines.japanese: 筝曲部とか人形劇部とかが似合いそうな小娘は、俺の腕の先からにへらっと振りかえった。俺はその体を押しだしながら歩く。
lines.english: The girl looked far better suited to a koto or puppetry club. She glanced back from the far end of my arm with a slack grin while I kept walking and pushed her ahead of me.

lines.japanese: 「なんで元なの」
lines.english: “Why *used to*?”

lines.japanese: 「やー、実は私、朝が弱くて」
lines.english: “Well, I'm not very good in the mornings.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、朝練イヤで挫折したの」
lines.english: “Oh. You couldn’t hack morning practice?”

lines.japanese: 「違いますよー。挫折して辞めたわけじゃありません、遅刻の多さを理由に追放されたんです」
lines.english: “No. I didn’t quit because I couldn’t hack it. They kicked me out for being late too often.”

lines.japanese: 「なお悪りーじゃん」
lines.english: “That's even worse.”

lines.japanese: 「言うほど多くはなかったんですよー。いじめられっ子は立場弱いんです」
lines.english: “It wasn't nearly as often as they made it sound. You don't have much standing when you're the kid everybody bullies.”

lines.japanese: 「知ってる」
lines.english: “I know.”

lines.japanese: 「でもリアクションしづれーから、そういう重たいこと言わないで」
lines.english: “But don't spring anything that heavy on me. I don't know how to react.”

lines.japanese: 俺は手を放した。ホーメイは逃げるのも忘れて、背中を丸めたまま前を歩く。やつは部活の話を再開した。
lines.english: I let her go. Forgetting all about escape, Phoenixsong walked ahead with her back hunched and resumed her story about the club.

lines.japanese: 「うーん、一応やる気だけはあったんですけどねー」
lines.english: “Hmm. I had enthusiasm, at least.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、だけじゃ駄目だろ。つーか朝起きらんねーぐらいのやる気は、やる気のうち入んねーだろ」
lines.english: “Enthusiasm alone isn't enough. If you can't get out of bed for morning practice, it doesn't count as enthusiasm.”

lines.japanese: 「あー、たぶん私ー、睡眠時無呼吸症候群のひとだと思うんですよー。だから充分な睡眠が取れない体なんです、きっと」
lines.english: “Oh, I probably have sleep apnea. My body must be incapable of getting enough sleep.”

lines.japanese: 「そんな難しいもんじゃねーだろ。ぶっちゃけ、ただのナマケだろ」
lines.english: “It isn't anything that complicated. Honestly, you're just lazy.”

lines.japanese: 「ひとを見かけで判断するのは良くないですよー」
lines.english: “You shouldn't judge people by appearances.”

lines.japanese: 「自分を思い込みで診断するのも良くないですよー」
lines.english: “And you shouldn't diagnose yourself on a hunch.”

lines.japanese: 「えー、だって夜とかそうだ私、こんなところでプー太郎の相手してる場合じゃなかった」
lines.english: “But at night—oh, right. I don't have time to stand around entertaining some unemployed bum.”

lines.japanese: ホーメイはなにか言いかけた途中でやめて、いきなり失礼なことを言いだした。ツッコミどころが多すぎて、俺は何も言いかえせなかった。
lines.english: Phoenixsong abandoned one thought halfway through and abruptly said something rude. There were too many possible retorts; I couldn't choose a single one.

lines.japanese: 「えー、ドラさん。わたくし自転車探しがありますので、ここらでドロンさせていただきます」
lines.english: “Dora, I have a bicycle to find, so I shall vanish in a puff of smoke.”

lines.japanese: やつは左右両方の中指と人差し指を立てて、それを縦に積んだ。年々後継者が減っている、前世紀の無形文化遺産。
lines.english: She raised the index and middle fingers of both hands and stacked the pairs vertically: an item of twentieth-century intangible cultural heritage, with fewer practitioners every year.

lines.japanese: 「いや、ドロンじゃなくて。待てって。だぁらおまえ、俺とあのハゲたちの会話聞いてねーのかよ。らー、もう帰んぞ。駅まで送ってってやるから」
lines.english: “Enough with the disappearing act. Wait. Weren't you listening to me and those bald men? Come on, we're going home. I'll take you to the station.”

lines.japanese: 「大丈夫ですってばー。あとちょっとだけですよー」
lines.english: “I told you, I'll be fine. Just a little longer.”

lines.japanese: 「いいから。明日にしろ」
lines.english: “Enough. Do it tomorrow.”

lines.japanese: 「だめです。今日できることを明日に延ばすなって、しらゆり幼稚園の永田先生が言ってました」
lines.english: “No. ‘Never put off until tomorrow what you can do today.’ Ms. Nagata at Shirayuri Kindergarten taught me that.”

lines.japanese: 「あァ？　てめ、永田の言うことが聞けて成田の言うことは聞けねーのか」
lines.english: “What? You'll listen to Ms. Nagata but not Narita?”

lines.japanese: 「すみません。三つ子の魂、百までですから」
lines.english: “Sorry. The things you learn young stay with you for life.”

lines.japanese: 「ＴＰＯ踏まえねー魂だな。もういい、おまえ黙ってろ。行くぞ、おう」
lines.english: “That soul of yours has no sense of time, place, or occasion. Enough. Shut up. We’re going.”

lines.japanese: 実力行使。俺は右手を伸ばして、ふたたび後ろから小娘の襟首を掴んだ。
lines.english: Time for force. I reached out with my right hand and once again caught the girl by the back of her collar.

lines.japanese: 「あふん」
lines.english: “Ahhn.”

lines.japanese: 「うるせえよ。キショい声出すな、女かてめえは」
lines.english: “Shut up. Don't make a creepy noise. What are you, a woman?”

lines.japanese: 「だーって、びっくりするじゃないですかー、いきなりそんな、うなじなんて撫でられたらー」
lines.english: “Buut you startled me, suddenly stroking the nape of my neck like that.”

lines.japanese: 「人聞きの悪りぃこと言ってんじゃねー。こんなん、うなじじゃねえ。ただの首根っこだ、ガキ」
lines.english: “Don't make it sound dirty. That isn't your nape. It's the scruff of your neck, brat.”

lines.japanese: 「いやいやー、これはあれですよー。きっと第三者が見たら、いまのドラさんあたかも少女誘拐犯ですよー。私まだまだ発展途上ですからねー。身長１５０ないですよー、いい感じにロリ入ってますよー」
lines.english: “No, no—think how this looks to a bystander. Right now you look exactly like a guy kidnapping a little girl, Dora. I’m still developing, you know. I’m under five feet tall. I’ve got just the right loli look going.”

lines.japanese: 「おやおやー、これはまずいですよー。ドラさん、歪んだ性癖を持ってることがばれちゃいますよー。とりわけ制服の少女に目がないことまでばれちゃいますよー」
lines.english: “Oh, dear. This is bad. Everyone will discover your warped appetites. They might even learn about your particular weakness for girls in uniform.”

lines.japanese: 俺はなんだか馬鹿らしくなって、うるさい手荷物をその場に投げすてた。
lines.english: The whole thing suddenly seemed too stupid for words, so I dropped the noisy piece of baggage where it stood.

lines.japanese: 「やったー、ナイスとんち私ー」
lines.english: “Yes! Brilliant thinking, me.”

lines.japanese: 束縛から逃れた小娘は、両手を脇に垂らして走りだす。
lines.english: Freed from captivity, the girl broke into a run with both arms dangling at her sides.

lines.japanese: 「おう、ちょーちょーちょー。待て。待てっておい」
lines.english: “Hey, wait, wait. Stop. I said stop.”

lines.japanese: 俺は歩幅を変えないまま、その背中に声を投げつけた。
lines.english: Without changing my stride, I threw the words at her retreating back.

lines.japanese: 「てめ、おとなしく連行されろ。逃げたらアレだ、マジ誘拐すんぞ。性的虐待とかすんぞ」
lines.english: “Come quietly. If you run, I'll actually kidnap you. Sexually abuse you and everything.”

lines.japanese: 「えええー」
lines.english: “What!?”

lines.japanese: ホーメイは足を止めて振りかえり、不服に満ちた顔で俺を睨んだ。
lines.english: Phoenixsong stopped and turned, glaring at me with grievance written across her face.

lines.japanese: 「あんさ、おまえさ、なんかこの構図おかしくね？　この俺様がお忙しい中、わざわざ駅まで送ってやんだぞ？　もっとありがたがれよ、ブッ殺すぞコノヤロウ」
lines.english: “Listen, don't you see something wrong with this picture? Great and busy as I am, I'm going out of my way to escort you to the station. Show some gratitude. I'll fucking kill you, asshole.”

lines.japanese: 「はあ、どうもです」
lines.english: “Why, thank you.”

lines.japanese: ありがたいと言うより、ありがた迷惑な顔でやつは言った。
lines.english: Her expression said the favor was considerably less welcome than her words did.

lines.japanese: 「あのう、ちょうっとお伺いしますが、ドラさんって寂しがりんぼなんですか？　それとも、真性の小児嗜好をお持ちなんですか？」
lines.english: “Um, may I ask you something? Dora, are you simply lonely? Or are you an honest-to-goodness pedophile?”

lines.japanese: 「おまえ、良かったなあ。俺が滅多なことじゃ怒らない人間で」
lines.english: “You're very lucky I'm a man who almost never gets angry.”

lines.japanese: 「あー、いえ。だってほらー、お手数かけるわけにはいかないじゃないですかー。私でしたらもう、その辺ほったらかしていただいて結構ですよー」
lines.english: “No, but I couldn't possibly put you to all this trouble. Please feel free to abandon me anywhere around here.”

lines.japanese: 「出来んならそうしてる」
lines.english: “If I could, I would.”

lines.japanese: そりゃそうだ。可能なかぎり鳳の身内になんか関わりたくないし、いや、それ以前に俺はバイト中なんだ。
lines.english: Obviously. I wanted as little as possible to do with Otori's relatives. More to the point, I was in the middle of a shift.

lines.japanese: でも、なあ……たとえば俺は、やつらの言ってた「キモくて目障りな連中」なんて言葉を思いだす。自称私設自警団の次なる標的、チーム名はＲなんたら。
lines.english: But... I remembered that phrase of theirs: ‘creepy eyesores.’ The self-appointed neighborhood watch's next target, a team called R-something.

lines.japanese: 鳳翔は無慈悲にこぶしを振りまわせる男だが、無差別に相手を選んだりはしない。やつが狙うのは暗がりでフルボッコにされてもお巡りさんには通報できないような、後ろぐらい何かを抱えてるバカタレ共だ。
lines.english: Kakeru Otori could wield his fists without mercy, but he did not choose his victims at random. He targeted idiots with something shady behind them—people who could be beaten senseless in the dark and still be unable to call the police.

lines.japanese: さっきのハゲやドレッドがホーメイを説得してたのだって、そういう蛮族を警戒してたのかもしれない。
lines.english: Maybe that was why Baldy and Dreads had been trying so hard to persuade Phoenixsong: they were watching out for savages like those.

lines.japanese: 「おう、行くぞオラ。終電なくなんだろ」
lines.english: “Come on. Move. You're going to miss the last train.”

lines.japanese: 俺はてのひらでブレザーの背中を一押しした。
lines.english: I gave the back of her blazer a push with my palm.

lines.japanese: 「はーん！」
lines.english: “Nooo!”

lines.japanese: やつは大袈裟につんのめりながら歩きだす。
lines.english: She pitched forward with theatrical exaggeration and began to walk.

lines.japanese: 駅まで片道１５分。帰りは走って戻れば、往復２０分のロスで済むだろうか。
lines.english: Fifteen minutes to the station one way. If I ran back, could I keep the round trip down to twenty minutes?

lines.japanese: さいわいヒゲの監督なら二時間は戻ってこないと言う。それでももしプリン達にチクられたら、今日は朝から下痢気味だったことにしよう。なんとか日当三割減ぐらいで許されるかもしれない。
lines.english: Fortunately, they said the bearded foreman would be gone for two hours. Even if Pudding-head and the others ratted me out, I could claim I’d had diarrhea since morning. Maybe they would let me off with only thirty percent docked from my day rate.

lines.japanese: 「はあ、とんでもないことになってしまった……」
lines.english: “Haaah. This has turned into a terrible mess...”

lines.japanese: 「俺のセリフ取んなよ」
lines.english: “Don't steal my line.”
